name: Piano
noAudio: Sound is not available in this browser
set.title: Piano
set.ftr: “Whole piano” rotates the keys together with the buttons inside the window. “Whole screen” rotates the whole session — hold the phone sideways.
syn.title: Piano sound
k.reset: Double-tap to reset to the preset
mix.ftr: Each instrument’s volume is in the drawer at the right edge of the screen.
about: Up to two octaves, sounds and your own presets
help.what: A keyboard for notes, chords and intonation.
help.2: Hold — a note sounds until tapped again.
help.3: Two rows, rotation and six timbres.
help.tip: Hold a reference chord to sing over.
pedal.sus: Sustain: a released note rings with a long tail
pedal.hold: Hold: a note keeps sounding until pressed again
slot.hint: Tap a preset — sound, hold — second layer
mode.hint: “Safe” — a large buffer, no dropouts on stage (default). “Low” — minimal response for playing keys, may crackle on a weak device.
perf.hint: Studio (default): all voices, pad unison, four reverb spaces. Lite is for weak devices: fewer voices, simpler pads, one reverb, always a large buffer.
